thread:
Ava Ruiz: Morning — planning a compact nurture for the mini-launch next Wed. Objective: drive webinar signups + benchmark blog reads. Doc: https://drive.redwood.ai/mini-launch-nurture
Sanjay Patel: High level segmentation? size estimates? want to avoid spamming trial users.
Marta Chen: Plan: two streams. 1) Engaged: opened/clicked in 30d -> 3-touch (educational, benchmark, invite). 2) Dormant: no engagement 30d -> 2-touch (soft intro + invite). Exclude trial_started_at in last 90d and unsubscribed. Estimated: engaged ~18k, dormant ~42k.
Leo Novak: Send windows: send at 10am local primary; second pass at 3pm for APAC. Use region-based batch keys to smooth. Stagger 15m between shards.
Ben Ortiz: Template will include dynamic blocks: region/time, CTA variant (Join demo vs Read benchmark). UTM: utm_medium=email&utm_source=mini_launch&utm_campaign=mini_runway_v1.
Sanjay Patel: Tracking: Looker dashboard marketing.mini_runway.v1. KPIs: open 22%, CTR 4%, webinar sign 5% for engaged.
deploy-bot: Current marketing throttle: 2500 msgs/min region, burst 5000/10m. See ops: https://ops.redwood.ai/batch-throttle
Ava Ruiz: Copy notes: for engaged use technical hooks + one benchmark stat; dormant gets benefits-first language. Subject tests: engaged A/B = "Benchmark: 3x inference cost reduction" vs "Live demo: lower latency & cost".
Marta Chen: Also add a small social proof block for the benchmark email — 1 quote + logo row.
Ben Ortiz: Will stage template and run 100-recipient smoke on Friday. Tagging @Ava for verification.
Ava Ruiz: Action items: Ben = template+smoke; Sanjay = final seg exports; Marta = copy + assets; Leo = send shard plan. Final review Monday AM. Tag me when tests complete. :rocket:
